Implemented lattice dispatch in:

  • python/treams_rs/lattice.py
  • tests/autodiff/test_lattice_dispatch.py

All 40 public lattice-sum functions now reuse diff.lattice_sum through the selected backend. NumPy paths retain scalar fast paths, out/where, metadata and ufunc attributes. Framework calls support scalar/planar shifts, nested geometry, broadcasting and constant Lattice/WaveVector objects.

Verified: 255 tests passed, including 61 new dispatch cases across Advect, JAX JIT, PyTorch and Autograd; Ruff passed. Tests uncovered an Autograd complex-cast gradient issue, fixed by its owning agent.

Measured smallest scalar NumPy call: original 0.905 µs, dispatched 1.961 µs; approximately 1.06 µs added.

Unchanged scope: lattice geometry functions without native derivative records. No builds, installations, commits, pushes or release contact performed.
